claims.statement: Rule set v18 is functioning correctly per specification; regression testing confirmed it matches expected behavior with no defects found
claims.corroboration: v18 replay against 14 days of historical orders; rule path matches specification; no defect found
claims.limitation: Regression testing did not exercise carrier scheduling interaction

claims.statement: The booking system allocates 30-minute pickup slot windows to split-reservation orders, but carrier confirmation latency is 47 minutes median, causing an interaction bug where slot windows close before confirmations arrive
claims.corroboration: Handoff trace measures timing mismatch (30 min slots vs 47 min confirmation). v18 specification matches regression results (no defect). Regression testing explicitly did not exercise carrier scheduling, explaining how this interaction bug escaped testing. One re-booked order with corrected slot succeeded, confirming the issue is slot duration, not v18 logic.
claims.limitation: The booking system's slot duration allocation logic is not directly inspected; would require code review of booking system to confirm exact mechanism

next_action.rationale: Root cause fully established with discriminating evidence (C22): booking system assigns 30-minute slot windows to split-reservation orders, but carrier confirmation latency is 47 minutes. Authorized operational mitigations attempted all failed. Root cause requires fix in booking system's slot duration logic. Assessment complete.
